observed_source_rules: Native vertices use argmax of summed MANO skinning weights in six anatomical groups; triangles use majority vertex labels, then group mean weights to break ties.
Shadow collision components use known body-name prefixes; forearm and wrist are separate groups; the fallback branch assigns palm.
All six saved compiled scenes have only the actual palm body entering that fallback. No current label-assignment implementation defect is established.
supported_claim: These rules implement a declared coarse anatomical correspondence for distance and orientation diagnostics.
unsupported_claims: No evidence here establishes one-to-one homologous material patches between MANO skin and Shadow collision components.
Part-label preservation alone does not establish physical contact or native outcome equivalence.
Individual collider-component boundaries, exposed union accessibility and MuJoCo pairwise contact outputs are different geometric/physical references.
next_algorithm_scope: Keep original labels/criteria frozen during the feasible-path correction; do not reinterpret failed rows as accepted by changing correspondence mid-fit.
